title: Write Pages as Clean .kiw Components
lead: The elegance of Svelte and Astro brought to Go. Frontmatter + HTML + scoped CSS in one intuitive file.
f1_html: Scoped by Default: Styles remain strictly isolated to the component.
f2_html: Global CSS via :root: Theme tokens cascade cleanly across layouts.
f3_html: Built into Krewire: Compiled natively via pkg/kiw with standard Go tooling.
f4_html: Light & Dark Mode: Native token switching via data-theme.
scoping_desc: Every .kiw component receives automatic data-kiw-component scope hashing at build time. No CSS collisions, no naming gymnastics, zero runtime cost.
